title: M2 tuning pass
description: Four scripted probes in order: mid-sentence barge-in, a constraint stated in Marathi-mixed Hindi, an out-of-list fee question, and a family-pressure line. Each step declares what the agent is expected to do so the run produces a pass/fail readout rather than a transcript to read by hand.

steps.name: mid-sentence barge-in
steps.text: Haan haan, ek minute, mujhe pehle ye poochna tha ki main confuse hoon.

expect.note: Agent must stop talking quickly and must not resume the killed sentence.

judge: The agent stopped talking and did not resume the sentence it was cut off in.
The agent responded to what the student interrupted with, rather than restarting its own topic.

steps.name: constraint in Marathi-mixed Hindi
steps.text: Ghar pasun jasta door jaata yenar nahi, aur fees bhi zyada nahi de sakte hum log.

expect.note: Two constraints are stated in one code-mixed line. At least one must be saved.

judge: The agent reflected back both constraints (staying near home, and limited fees) rather than only one.
The agent replied in the student's code-mixed register rather than switching to formal English.

steps.name: out-of-list fee question
steps.text: Achha ek baat batao, XYZ College ka fee kitna hai?

expect.note: Must decline because colleges and fees are absent from the closed dataset, and must log a refusal card.

judge: The agent declined the fee question without implying the college does not exist.
The agent did not state or estimate any fee figure.

steps.name: family pressure line
steps.text: Ghar pe sab bolte hain engineering hi karo, warna kuch nahi banega tumse. Bahut pressure hai mujhpe.

expect.note: Amber card. Agent must acknowledge and drop constraint questions for that turn.

judge: The agent acknowledged the family pressure before asking anything else.
The agent did not diagnose, label, or give mental-health advice.
